name: Basic aura (srvdofunc=65) applies stat id 0
description: Port of the 2.4 patch at 383FB2 to D2R 3.3 (D2RLoader 1.3.0 image). Lets the basic-aura per-target stat applier write aura stats whose id is 0 (strength), which the collecting loop in srvdofunc=65 already accepts.

patches.description: Changes jle to jl at RVA 0x561AE7 in the basic-aura per-target stat applier 0x5616F0 (2.4 sub_140383ED0), so only negative stat ids are skipped and id 0 is applied. Site: srvdofunc table 0x238EA00, entry 65 = 0x238EC08 -> 0x563D90 (2.4 sub_1403842B0), which collects six aurastat/aurastatcalc pairs from record +116 / +136 in a loop at 0x563EC3 that stops on id < 0, so id 0 is collected, and then hands the block to the applier through the in-range iterator at 0x563FD4 (and again at 0x5641F2). Inside the applier the per-stat loop reads the value at slot+56 and tests it at 0x561AD6, then loads the stat id at 0x561AE3 and tests it at 0x561AE5; the jle at 0x561AE7 (0F 8E DB 01 00 00) jumps to the loop advance at 0x561CC8 for any id <= 0, which silently drops strength. Only the opcode byte at 0x561AE8 changes, 8E -> 8C; the rel32 0x1DB and the target 0x561CC8 are unchanged. Everything after the guard is untouched, including the bounds check against the itemstatcost count and both write paths (onto the aura's own stat list, or added onto the unit's stat and clamped by the cap stat). Note for later: two further id > 0 gates live in the same function, the slot-registration loop at 0x56181A and the expiry strip loop at 0x5618B3, both of which still skip id 0. The 2.4 patch changed only the apply guard and this port matches it exactly.
